title: GFT Technologies holds Camunda Platinum twice plus Flowable, but is a committee sale
content:
GFT Technologies SE holds Camunda Platinum status twice over — through its Italian and Polish organisations — and also appears as a Flowable partner. Platinum is the top certification tier, and holding it in two delivery countries at once is the strongest Camunda credential in the sweep.

That credential is also what defines the obstacle. A listed enterprise in financial services, delivering from Stuttgart with Italian and Polish delivery centres, buys new technology through a committee: alliance management scores it against existing partner commitments, architecture review governs the reference stack, and Platinum status itself creates an obligation to the incumbent vendor. The record's own summary is committee sale, and that is what holds the row at priority 3 rather than any doubt about capability.

The entity split is worth carrying separately. GFT's UK arm appears elsewhere in the same corpus filed at priority 9 on banking-only positioning aimed at tier-1 banks, with its stack never researched. Same group, two rows, two verdicts nine priority points apart — the assessments are entity-level, and neither row closes the other. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder, mined 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
